rationale: itnet-claude-agentic: pretrain_epochs=220, pretrain_lr=0.0001, itnet_k=3, itnet_alpha=0.005, unet_c=16, finetune_epochs=0, finetune_lr=0.0001, train_n=200, val_n=214, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, rationale=ITER-4 (search-20260619-01, corrected 214-slice/321px-FOV metric) for itnet = ItNet v1 (pretrain-denoiser-then-FIXED-DC, solver_itnet.py). This is a CONFIRMATION iter -- the solver is well-characterized; the goal is to confirm the asymptote of the only trainable lever, not to find a breakthrough. SIX-BOX (NUMBERS, not CT pixels). (1) PRIOR RESULTS (val=ALL 214 L277 slices, 321px detector-geometry FOV): iter-1 ep8 -> SSIM 0.4413 / hr 0.000, elapsed 191.1s; iter-2 ep48 -> SSIM 0.5927 / hr 0.000, elapsed 387.4s; iter-3 ep160 -> SSIM 0.6430 / hr 0.000, PSNR 24.67, RMSE 0.002922, elapsed 858.9s, params_M 0.2329. The pretrain_epochs lever is in clear diminishing returns: SSIM deltas are +0.151 (8->48), then +0.050 (48->160); hr has stayed PINNED at 0.000 across ALL three iters -- v1 remains BELOW the ~0.81 LD-FBP floor (and far below the END-TO-END sibling itnet_v3's ~0.91 / hr ~0.31). v1 (0.44->0.59->0.64) and its lever-twin itnet_v2 (0.59->0.62) trace the SAME under-0.81 curve; v3 is on a different curve entirely. (2) LIMITER = the pretrain-then-FIXED-DC CEILING (structural, confirmed by reading solver_itnet.py): finetune_itnet() is DEFINED (lines 114-135) but NEVER called in main(); the k=3 ItNet DC unroll (forward, lines 76-90) has ZERO trainable params (self.alpha is a plain float, self.projector is fixed analytic PYRO-NN); itnet.eval()+torch.no_grad() (lines 208-209) run the unroll as pure INFERENCE. The ONLY trainable component is the standalone SmallUNet denoiser (params_M=0.2329), pretrained as an FBP->truth denoiser that NEVER sees the DC steps. pretrain_epochs is the sole lever and the fixed untrained DC post-processor caps v1 far below v3. (3) ONE KNOB: pretrain_epochs 160 -> 220 (1.375x). All else identical to iter-3 (k=3, itnet_alpha=0.005, unet_c=16, pretrain_lr=1e-4, train_n=200, val_n=214, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42). (4) HYPOTHESIS + FALSIFIER: a final confirmation push of the only trainable component to nail the asymptote. HYPOTHESIS: SSIM lands ~0.65 (asymptoting -- the diminishing +0.151 -> +0.050 slope predicts roughly +0.01-class for 160->220), hr STAYS 0.000. FALSIFIER (the operative one): if hr is STILL 0.000 (SSIM ~0.65, well below the ~0.81 LD-FBP floor and far below v3's 0.91), the pretrain-then-FIXED-DC architecture is STRUCTURALLY capped -- NOT under-trained -- and the campaign should FILE THE STRUCTURAL VERDICT for itnet v1 (epochs lever exhausted; future Mayo recon goes to the end-to-end itnet_v3, ~0.91) rather than spend more iters on v1's epochs. The counter-hypothesis (v1 suddenly clears 0.81 at 220 ep) is implausible given the measured +0.151 -> +0.050 slope. (5) BUDGET (HARD 20-min = 1200s train+score): from the two latest measured points the per-epoch pretrain cost is (858.9-387.4)/(160-48) = 4.21 s/epoch and the fixed cost (data load + 214-slice per-sample val + figure + startup) is 858.9 - 160*4.21 = 185.3 s (this exactly reproduces iter-3: 185.3 + 160*4.21 = 858.9). pretrain_epochs=220 predicts 185.3 + 220*4.21 = 1111 s = 18.5 min, inside the 1200s budget with ~1.5 min margin; ep240 would predict 1196s (too tight), so 220 is the largest safe confirmation push. The sbatch wall is 30 min, so the 18.5-min prediction leaves ample fence headroom. val stays ALL 214 L277 slices, 321px detector-geometry FOV (default; NO fov= override). grad_clip=1.0 retained (mandatory: the 2304-view Mayo FBP adjoint inside the DC step overflows otherwise). v1 has NO max_train_s backstop, so the 30-min sbatch wall is the only hard fence. (6) Loop continues -- no control returned. HARD-WIRED (unchanged): staged_canonical data, v3 mayo_ldct_fitted geometry, per-sample-ps (each val slice swaps itnet.projector to its own ps; chunk=1 FORCED), bg_target=truth, val=ALL 214 L277 slices under the 321px detector-geometry FOV (evaluate_calibrated default for AGENT4CT_DATASET=mayo_ldct_2d; NO fov= override).
